links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to lung cancer guideline questions with vs without RAG or MCP
links.effect: Baseline accuracy 36-50% (o3 50%, GPT 48%, Gemini 48%, Grok 44%, Qwen 40%, Claude 36%); RAG or MCP significantly improved accuracy over baseline LLMs.
links.quote: However, implementing RAG (LLM-RAG) or MCP (LLM-MCP) significantly improved accuracy, with statistical differences observed between baseline LLMs and their RAG- or MCP-enhanced counterparts.

screen.practice: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
screen.reason: The study directly compares baseline LLM performance to versions augmented with deployment safeguards/knowledge-grounding techniques (RAG and MCP) on lung cancer clinical guideline questions.
